headline: Proposed Single Room Occupancy/Efficiency Housing ordinance, plus liquor license applications for Cosgrove Liquors and two one-day events.
summary: City Planning Staff will present a proposed ordinance on Single Room Occupancy/Efficiency Housing. The agenda also lists a manager change for Cosgrove Liquors and two one-day liquor license applications.
items: Change of officer/director, stock interest, and manager for Krishiv, Inc. d/b/a Cosgrove Liquors at 26 Bridge Street, Salem. Proposed manager: Jagdishkumar Patel.
One-Day Liquor License on November 13, 2026, at Salem Arts Association, 88 Wharf Street, Salem, from 5pm to 9pm. Applicant: Salem Arts Association. Number of people: 75.
One Day Liquor License on December 10, 2026, at Root NS, Inc., 35 Congress Street, Salem. Applicant: Root NS, Inc. Number of people: 30.
City Planning Staff presentation on a proposed Ordinance relative to Single Room Occupancy/Efficiency Housing, with discussion of the proposed Ordinance and the Board's Lodging House Regulations.
